notes.subject: בתחבולתו
notes.rationale: Lit. 'long pasin bilong holem rop bilong kanu' — steerage/manisman bilong sip; tanim olsem 'plan bilong en', piksa bilong sailing i lus.

notes.subject: em
notes.rationale: Pronoun bilong God (Elihu i tok long Yahwe) — ⟨em⟩ i bracket, Hibru i gat והוא tasol em i strongpela emphatic.

translation: Na ⟨em⟩ i tanim ol i go raunabaut, ol i senis long plan bilong en bilong wokim ol wok bilong olgeta; olgeta samting we em i givim tok long ol, long pes bilong graun we man i stap long en, long graun.
